Bone fragility, osteoporosis and skeletal deformities define OI12; impaired dental eruption reported in 1/1 patient. Cardiovascular abnormalities occur in 5-29%.
Defining radial/thumb malformations, urethral hypospadias and maxillary dental diastema. Dermatoglyphic differences do not establish skin damage.
HBA1-related hemoglobin disorder defined by mild microcytic anemia.
Hereditary localized loss of occipital hair pigmentation; no additional organ disease described.
Neuroendocrine hormone secretion defines the syndrome. Flushing and diarrhea alone do not establish tissue damage; underlying tumors are separate; cardiac lesions occur in 5-29%.
Nonsyndromic X-linked intellectual disability; sensorineural hearing impairment occurs in only 5-29%.
Skeletal dysplasia defined by vertebral flattening, short trunk and scoliosis across the group.
Skin pigmentation disorder; systemic abnormalities of individual syndromic subtypes do not apply across this umbrella.
Inherited enzyme deficiency impairs methemoglobin reduction and functional hemoglobin. Generalized neurologic injury is not established for this concept.
Syndromic intellectual disability defines neurologic involvement; short stature and facial dysmorphism alone do not establish another damaged organ.
Neurodevelopmental movement disorder defined by motor or vocal tics.
Inherited epidermal fragility with blistering and migratory circinate erythema; skin blistering reported in 9/9 patients.
Crystalline lens opacity directly impairs vision; causes associated with particular cataract subtypes are not universal.
Inherited marrow failure; developmental delay reported in 20/20. Structural skeletal/limb anomalies affect roughly 40-50% in Fanconi anemia; renal anomaly frequency is less certain.
Isolated dilated cardiomyopathy with reduced left ventricular ejection fraction in 3/3 patients.
Intellectual disability and skeletal malformations define the syndrome; bilateral eyelid ptosis occurs in 30-79%. Cardiac, renal and airway abnormalities individually occur in 5-29%.
Heme synthesis defect causes cutaneous phototoxic injury. Liver failure affects ~5%; anemia frequency is variable and not securely above 30%; gallstones are a separate diagnosis.
Combined immunodeficiency with erythroid/myeloid hypoplasia and reduced IgG; no additional common organ damage established.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability are common defining manifestations; other organ malformations vary with duplication extent.
Familial susceptibility to breast cancer; breast has no axis, and susceptibility alone does not establish damage to another organ.
Peripheral nerve injury caused by a vitamin deficiency; both neuropathy and the nutritional metabolic deficiency define the concept.
Antigen-driven, immune-mediated granulomatous inflammation directly occupies and damages skin.
Intellectual disability, cerebral atrophy and developmental delay define neurologic disease. Structural clubfoot reported in 1/2 patients; hypotonia alone does not establish muscle damage.
Complex congenital cardiac and venous malformations dominate. Midline liver, ectopic spleen and polysplenia do not by themselves establish hepatic or hematologic dysfunction.
